quote: The MOU between EXIM and the government of Barbados, in the amount of up to $500 million in financing, was signed by Chair Lewis and Prime Minister Mia Mottley in the Office of the Prime Minister … Areas for cooperation and procurement included renewable energy, cybersecurity, water and sanitation and maritime domain awareness.
note: Opened EXIM English release 25 Nov 2024 (Barbados MOU up to USD 500m).
